reasons: postgresql.tup_updated is a monotonic sum counting updated rows, matching the Datadog rows-updated quantity shown per second.
rate() over the monotonic sum yields the per-second rate, matching the '(per sec)' unit of the widget.
avg() with no by-clause matches Datadog avg: one series across all matching series.
$scope has no tag prefix and default '*', so it is correctly dropped.
Only dataset-observed label names are relevant and none are used in the selector, so no label-name issue arises.
